item.title_zh: 新增了一些功能并修复了一些已知问题
item.title_en: Added some new features and fixed some known issues.

changes.content_zh:
新增功能

1. MediaTek 设备解锁 Bootloader

新增对 MediaTek 平台设备的 Bootloader 解锁支持，无需依赖第三方工具即可完成解锁操作。解锁流程已集成至对应模块，操作路径更直观。

2. 一加离线授权功能

针对一加设备新增离线授权机制，目前仅支持 一加 7 / 8 / 9 三个系列的部分设备。在无网络或授权服务器不可达的情况下仍可完成授权验证，有效应对临时断网、服务器维护等场景，提升刷机流程的连续性与成功率。

使用方法（均需勾选“一加离线授权”）：

1. 仅联机操作

需要提前准备设备项目编号。选择与设备匹配的引导文件，若该机型区分 DDR 版本，则还需确保引导的 DDR 类型与设备一致；勾选后联机过程中会提示输入项目号。联机成功后即可执行正常的读取分区表、回读分区、擦除分区、写入分区等操作。

2. 无法提供引导时

可导入与设备相符的固件包，勾选后支持通过固件包内的引导与设备联机，无需自行准备引导，也无需手动填写项目号。

3. 执行刷机操作

导入固件包后，将设备进入 9008 端口，勾选后直接写入分区即可。程序会自动发送引导联机，无需手动填写项目号。

注意事项：

一加离线授权模式下，“保护 LUN5”复选框不可勾选，也不要手动取消 LUN5 的刷写；部分机器无 OCDT 分区，刷写过程中不要勾选“更新 OCDT”；此外，“写入下载完成标识”在部分设备上不可用。

changes.content_en:
New Features

1. MediaTek Bootloader Unlock

Added Bootloader unlock support for MediaTek devices, allowing unlock operations to be completed without relying on third-party tools. The unlock process is integrated into the corresponding module, making the workflow more straightforward.

2. OnePlus Offline Authorization

Added an offline authorization mechanism for OnePlus devices. Currently only select devices in the OnePlus 7 / 8 / 9 series are supported. It allows authorization verification to complete even without a network connection or when the authorization server is unreachable, effectively handling temporary disconnections, server maintenance, and similar situations to improve continuity and success rate of the flashing process.

Instructions (all require checking "OnePlus Offline Authorization"):

1. Connect-only operations

Prepare the device project number in advance. Select a boot file that matches the device; if the model distinguishes DDR versions, make sure the boot file's DDR type also matches the device. After checking the option, you will be prompted to enter the project number during connection. Once connected, you can perform normal operations such as reading the partition table, reading back partitions, erasing partitions, and writing partitions.

2. When you cannot provide a boot file

Import a firmware package that matches the device. After checking the option, you can connect to the device using the boot file inside the firmware package, with no need to prepare a boot file yourself or manually enter the project number.

3. Flashing operations

After importing the firmware package, put the device into 9008 port and check the option, then simply write the partitions. The program will automatically send the boot file and connect, with no need to manually enter the project number.

Notes:

In OnePlus Offline Authorization mode, the "Protect LUN5" checkbox must not be checked, and do not manually uncheck LUN5 flashing. Some devices do not have an OCDT partition, so do not check "Update OCDT" during flashing. In addition, "Write download complete flag" is unavailable on some devices.
